newsitem.title: UK: Stakis ups bank lines to 330 mln stg for Metropole.
newsitem.headline: Stakis ups bank lines to 330 mln stg for Metropole.

text.p: LONDON, October 31 (LPC) - Stakis Plc has increased its bank borrowing lines to 330 million stg to help finance its purchase of five luxury Metropole hotels from Lonhro Plc for 327 million stg, Stakis finance director Neil Chisman said.
Stakis has recast a series of bilateral loans from five banks, increasing the total amount to 330 million and extending maturities, Chisman said.
Bank of Scotland, Barclays Bank, Clydesdale Bank, Royal Bank of Scotland and Societe Generale extended the loans, which are on identical terms.
The loans comprise 185 million stg in three year revolving term loans, 115 million stg in five year term loans and 30 million stg in multi-option facilities. Pricing is 55 bps over LIBOR.
Stakis is also financing the purchase through a four-for- seven rights issue to raise 222 million stg.
Chisman said that borrowing for the acquisition will not drive gearing at Stakis above its self-imposed limit of 50 percent.
